query: Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB 모델의 공식 출고가는 얼마인가?
verification_sql: SELECT factory_price_krw AS factory_price FROM `{fq}.tb_device_master` WHERE device_name = 'Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB'

query: Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB를 5G Premier Essential(85,000원) 요금제로 개통할 때 총 지원금과 실구매가는?
verification_sql: SELECT s.base_subsidy_krw + s.additional_subsidy_cap_krw AS subsidy, d.factory_price_krw - s.base_subsidy_krw - s.additional_subsidy_cap_krw AS net_price FROM `{fq}.tb_subsidy_policy` s JOIN `{fq}.tb_device_master` d ON d.device_id = s.device_id JOIN `{fq}.tb_plan_master` p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE d.device_name = 'Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB' AND p.plan_name = '5G Premier Essential' AND p.monthly_fee_krw = 85000

query: CUST_DEMO_001 고객이 개통 후 120일 시점에 5G Slim(45,000원) 미만인 5G Light(37,000원) 요금제로 하향 변경 시 차액정산 위약금은?
verification_sql: SELECT CAST(ROUND((s0.base_subsidy_krw - s1.base_subsidy_krw) * (s0.mandatory_retention_days - 120) / s0.mandatory_retention_days) AS INT64) AS penalty FROM `{fq}.tb_customer_contract` c JOIN `{fq}.tb_subsidy_policy` s0 ON s0.device_id = c.device_id AND s0.plan_id = c.plan_id JOIN `{fq}.tb_plan_master` t ON t.monthly_fee_krw = 37000 JOIN `{fq}.tb_subsidy_policy` s1 ON s1.device_id = c.device_id AND s1.plan_id = t.plan_id WHERE c.customer_id = 'CUST_DEMO_001'

query: Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB + 5G Premier Essential(85,000원) 24개월 유지 시 공시지원금과 선택약정(25%) 중 유리한 조건과 절감액은?
expected_value: 공시지원금 유리 (공시지원금 총액 517,500원 vs 선택약정 할인 총액 510,000원 · 24개월 총비용 차액 7,500원)
verification_sql: SELECT s.base_subsidy_krw + s.additional_subsidy_cap_krw AS public_subsidy_total, CAST(ROUND(p.monthly_fee_krw * p.selective_discount_rate * 24) AS INT64) AS selective_discount_total, ABS(CAST(ROUND(d.factory_price_krw + p.monthly_fee_krw * (1 - p.selective_discount_rate) * 24) AS INT64) - (d.factory_price_krw - s.base_subsidy_krw - s.additional_subsidy_cap_krw + p.monthly_fee_krw * 24)) AS tco_savings FROM `{fq}.tb_subsidy_policy` s JOIN `{fq}.tb_device_master` d ON d.device_id = s.device_id JOIN `{fq}.tb_plan_master` p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE d.device_name = 'Galaxy S26 Ultra 256GB' AND p.monthly_fee_krw = 85000

query: CUST_DEMO_003(시니어 복지 대상) 고객이 개통 88일차에 시니어 요금제로 변경할 때 위약금 면제 여부와 근거 규정 앵커를 확인해줘.
verification_sql: SELECT IF(c.welfare_status = 'SENIOR_EXEMPT', 0, NULL) AS penalty, r.rule_id AS exemption_rule FROM `{fq}.tb_customer_contract` c JOIN `{fq}.tb_domain_rules` r ON r.rule_category = 'WELFARE_EXEMPT' WHERE c.customer_id = 'CUST_DEMO_003'
